name: Butter Croissant
story: Laminated dough folded with cold butter into dozens of flaky layers, baked until crisp outside and honeycomb-soft inside.
steps: Fold cold butter into the dough in three turns, chilling between each.
Roll out, cut triangles and shape into crescents.
Proof until puffy, then bake at 200°C until deep golden.
tip: Keep the butter cold at every fold.

name: Fluffy Pancakes
story: A tall stack of buttermilk pancakes with golden edges and soft centres, finished with maple syrup and butter.
steps: Whisk buttermilk, eggs and melted butter, then fold into the dry mix.
Ladle onto a buttered pan over medium heat.
Flip when bubbles form and serve with maple syrup.
tip: Rest the batter 10 minutes and don't overmix.

name: Masala Dosa
story: A crisp fermented rice-and-lentil crepe folded around a spiced potato filling, served with coconut chutney and sambar.
steps: Spread fermented batter thin on a hot griddle.
Cook the potato masala with mustard seeds, onion and turmeric.
Fill, fold and serve with chutney and sambar.
tip: Keep the griddle hot and lightly oiled.

name: Shakshuka
story: Eggs poached in a smoky, spiced tomato and pepper sauce, mopped up with warm bread.
steps: Soften onion and pepper, add garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes and simmer into a thick sauce.
Crack in eggs, cover and cook until just set.
tip: Pull it off the heat while the yolks are still soft.

name: Punjabi Samosa
story: Crisp, flaky pastry parcels stuffed with spiced potato and peas, fried until golden.
steps: Make a firm dough with flour, oil and salt.
Cook the spiced potato and pea filling.
Shape cones, fill, seal and fry on low heat.
tip: Fry slowly so the crust blisters and stays crisp.

name: Tomato Bruschetta
story: Grilled rustic bread rubbed with garlic and topped with juicy tomatoes, basil and olive oil.
steps: Grill thick slices of bread until charred.
Rub with a cut garlic clove.
Top with tomatoes, basil, oil and salt.
tip: Salt the tomatoes 10 minutes before serving.

name: Wood-fired Margherita
story: Slow-fermented dough, San Marzano tomatoes, fresh mozzarella and basil, blistered in a very hot oven.
steps: Stretch rested dough by hand into a thin round.
Top with crushed tomato, torn mozzarella and olive oil.
Bake very hot until blistered, then add basil.
tip: Go as hot as your oven allows.

name: Salmon Nigiri Platter
story: Silky salmon over lightly vinegared rice, brushed with soy and finished with a touch of wasabi.
steps: Cook sushi rice and season with rice vinegar while warm.
Shape small oval rice pieces with wet hands.
Top with sliced salmon and a dot of wasabi.
tip: Wet your hands so the rice doesn't stick.

name: Dum Biryani
story: Fragrant basmati layered with marinated meat, fried onions, saffron and mint, slow-cooked on dum.
steps: Marinate meat with yoghurt and spices for 2 hours.
Par-boil the rice, then layer with meat, onions and saffron milk.
Seal the pot and cook on low heat for 40 minutes.
tip: Seal the pot with dough to trap the steam.

name: Butter Chicken
story: Tender tandoori-style chicken simmered in a silky tomato, butter and cream sauce.
steps: Marinate chicken in yoghurt and spices, then grill.
Simmer tomato puree with butter and spices.
Add chicken and cream, finish with dried fenugreek.
tip: Crush kasuri methi between your palms first.

name: Tonkotsu Ramen
story: A rich pork-bone broth simmered overnight, springy noodles, soft-boiled egg, chashu and spring onion.
steps: Simmer pork bones 10 to 12 hours for a creamy broth.
Marinate soft-boiled eggs and slice the chashu.
Cook noodles, assemble in hot broth and top.
tip: Marinate the eggs for 6 hours.

name: Pad Thai
story: Stir-fried rice noodles in a sweet, sour and salty tamarind sauce with prawns, egg and crushed peanuts.
steps: Soak the rice noodles until pliable.
Stir-fry prawns, then push aside and scramble the egg.
Toss noodles with sauce, sprouts and peanuts.
tip: Cook in small batches over very high heat.

name: Seafood Paella
story: Saffron rice cooked in a wide pan with prawns, mussels and squid until a crisp golden crust forms.
steps: Fry seafood lightly and make a tomato sofrito.
Add rice, saffron and stock, and don't stir.
Cook until a crust (socarrat) forms on the bottom.
tip: Listen for a gentle crackle: that's the socarrat.

name: Classic Lasagne
story: Layers of pasta, slow-cooked ragù, silky béchamel and parmesan, baked until bubbling.
steps: Simmer the ragù for at least an hour.
Layer pasta, ragù and béchamel.
Top with cheese and bake until golden.
tip: Rest it 15 minutes before cutting.

name: Street Tacos
story: Warm corn tortillas with charred, spiced meat, onion, coriander and a squeeze of lime.
steps: Marinate meat with chilli, garlic, lime and cumin, then grill.
Warm the tortillas over a flame.
Fill with meat, onion, coriander and lime.
tip: Toast tortillas straight on the flame.

name: Smash Burger
story: Beef pressed on a screaming-hot griddle for a lacy crust, with melted cheese, pickles and a soft bun.
steps: Roll beef into loose balls and season generously.
Smash on a hot griddle 60 seconds, flip, add cheese.
Build on a toasted bun with pickles and sauce.
tip: Smash once, then leave it alone.

name: Falafel Wrap
story: Crisp chickpea fritters herbed with parsley and coriander, wrapped in warm flatbread with tahini.
steps: Blend soaked raw chickpeas with herbs and spices.
Shape into balls and deep-fry until deep golden.
Wrap with salad, pickles and tahini.
tip: Use soaked, not canned, chickpeas.

name: Classic Tiramisu
story: Espresso-soaked savoiardi layered with whipped mascarpone cream and dusted with cocoa.
steps: Whisk yolks and sugar, then fold in mascarpone.
Dip ladyfingers briefly in espresso and layer with cream.
Chill overnight and dust with cocoa.
tip: Dip the biscuits for just two seconds.

name: Gulab Jamun
story: Soft milk-solid dumplings fried golden and soaked in cardamom and rose sugar syrup.
steps: Knead khoya, paneer and flour into a smooth dough.
Shape small balls and fry slowly in ghee.
Soak in warm cardamom-rose syrup for an hour.
tip: Fry on low heat so the centres cook through.

name: Mango Lassi
story: A thick, chilled yoghurt drink blended with ripe mango and a pinch of cardamom.
steps: Blend mango, yoghurt and milk until smooth.
Sweeten and add a pinch of cardamom.
Serve over ice with chopped pistachios.
tip: Use Alphonso mangoes when in season.

name: Masala Chai
story: Strong black tea simmered with milk, ginger and warming spices.
steps: Simmer water with ginger and whole spices.
Add tea leaves and boil until dark.
Add milk, bring to a boil and strain.
tip: Boil it twice for a deeper flavour.

name: Idli & Sambar
story: Soft steamed rice-and-lentil cakes served with sambar and coconut chutney.
steps: Ferment rice and urad dal batter overnight.
Pour into greased idli moulds.
Steam 12 minutes and serve hot with sambar.
tip: Ferment in a warm spot for fluffier idlis.

name: French Toast
story: Thick slices of brioche soaked in custard and pan-fried golden, dusted with cinnamon sugar.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon and vanilla.
Soak bread slices 30 seconds each side.
Fry in butter until golden and serve with syrup.
tip: Use slightly stale bread so it soaks without falling apart.

name: Creamy Hummus
story: Silky chickpea and tahini dip with lemon and olive oil, served with warm pita.
steps: Boil chickpeas until very soft.
Blend with tahini, lemon, garlic and ice water.
Serve drizzled with olive oil and paprika.
tip: Blend for a full 4 minutes for a smooth texture.

name: Pan-fried Gyoza
story: Pan-fried dumplings with crisp bottoms and a juicy pork and cabbage filling.
steps: Mix the filling and season with soy and sesame oil.
Fold into pleated half-moons.
Fry, add water and cover to steam, then crisp again.
tip: Add water to the pan only after the bottoms brown.

name: Fresh Ceviche
story: Fresh white fish cured in lime juice with chilli, red onion and coriander.
steps: Cut very fresh fish into small cubes.
Toss with lime juice, salt, chilli and onion.
Rest 10 minutes and serve with sweet potato.
tip: Serve within 15 minutes or the fish turns chalky.

name: Fish and Chips
story: Crisp beer-battered fish with thick golden chips, mushy peas and tartar sauce.
steps: Cut potatoes and fry twice for crisp chips.
Dip fish in cold beer batter.
Fry until golden and serve with vinegar and tartar sauce.
tip: Keep the batter ice cold for the crispiest crust.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
story: Spaghetti with crisp guanciale, egg yolk, pecorino and black pepper, no cream.
steps: Crisp the guanciale slowly in its own fat.
Mix yolks, pecorino and pepper into a paste.
Toss hot pasta off the heat with the paste and pasta water.
tip: Take the pan off the heat so the eggs don't scramble.

name: Beef Pho
story: A fragrant beef broth with rice noodles, herbs and lime, simmered with charred ginger and star anise.
steps: Char ginger and onion, then simmer with bones and spices for 6 hours.
Cook rice noodles and slice beef thinly.
Ladle boiling broth over noodles and top with herbs and lime.
tip: Skim the broth often for a clear finish.

name: Bibimbap
story: Warm rice topped with seasoned vegetables, beef, a fried egg and spicy gochujang, mixed at the table.
steps: Sauté each vegetable separately with sesame oil.
Cook the marinated beef and fry an egg.
Arrange over rice and mix with gochujang.
tip: Use a hot stone bowl for a crispy rice bottom.

name: Chole Bhature
story: Spicy chickpea curry with puffy deep-fried bhature bread, a Punjabi favourite.
steps: Simmer chickpeas with onion, tomato and chole masala.
Knead bhature dough with yoghurt and rest 2 hours.
Roll and deep-fry until puffed.
tip: Add a tea bag while boiling the chickpeas for a dark colour.

name: Tom Yum Soup
story: Hot and sour lemongrass soup with prawns, mushrooms, galangal and lime.
steps: Simmer lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves in stock.
Add mushrooms and prawns and cook 3 minutes.
Finish with lime juice, fish sauce and chilli.
tip: Add lime juice off the heat to keep it bright.

name: Vada Pav
story: Mumbai's street burger: a spicy potato fritter in a soft pav with garlic chutney.
steps: Mash potatoes with spices and shape into balls.
Dip in gram-flour batter and deep-fry.
Tuck into a toasted pav with chutneys.
tip: Smear the pav with garlic chutney generously.

name: Chicken Shawarma
story: Spiced, thinly shaved roast meat wrapped in flatbread with garlic sauce and pickles.
steps: Marinate chicken with yoghurt, cumin and paprika.
Roast or grill until charred, then slice thin.
Wrap with garlic sauce, pickles and salad.
tip: Slice the meat thin against the grain.

name: Berry Cheesecake
story: A creamy baked cheesecake on a buttery biscuit base with a berry topping.
steps: Press buttered biscuit crumbs into a tin.
Beat cream cheese with sugar and eggs and pour in.
Bake gently, chill overnight and top with berries.
tip: Bake in a water bath to prevent cracks.

name: Pistachio Baklava
story: Paper-thin phyllo layered with pistachios and soaked in honey syrup.
steps: Layer buttered phyllo sheets with crushed pistachios.
Cut into diamonds and bake until golden.
Pour cool syrup over the hot baklava.
tip: Pour cold syrup on hot pastry for a crisp finish.

name: Fresh Lemonade
story: Fresh-squeezed lemonade, sweet, tart and served over plenty of ice.
steps: Dissolve sugar in warm water to make a syrup.
Add fresh lemon juice and chill.
Serve over ice with mint.
tip: Add a tiny pinch of salt to lift the flavour.
